description:
Free Look Period allows the policyholder 15 days as free-look period from the date of receipt of the policy document.
Policyholder is allowed to cancel the policy during this period and get a refund.

In this video, we have discussed the process to Cancel your Health Insurance & Life Insurance Policy in the Free Look Period. Also, discussed whether the premiums are fully refunded or not at the time of Cancellation
